title: libartifact: retag/delete unnamed artifact orphans
body:
<!--- Please read the [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/containers/container-libs/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) before proceeding --->

When you re-pull the same tag and the digest changes, `c/image` drops `org.opencontainers.image.ref.name` on the old index entry. That leaves an unnamed manifest and breaks artifact ls.

This PR retags those entries to `repo@sha256:…` after pull (design doc B1) and deletes any still-unnamed entries when the store is opened (C1), for stores that were already broken.

Design: https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/blob/main/contrib/design-docs/artifact-unnamed-orphans.md
Fixes: https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/28033
